claim_boundary.statement: This is a new deterministic verification conditional on the surviving unmanifested cache; it is not provenance for, or a reproduction of, the historical unseeded Monte Carlo run.

method.coherence: mean over all within-group axis pairs of article-mean cosine similarity
method.null: complete enumeration of every equally likely axes-sized subset from 3*axes
method.pc1: global center pooled [N, 3*axes, D] vectors; torch.svd; subtract PC1 projection
method.tail: upper tail, statistic >= observed ideology coherence
